params.detail: the register answers one question — whether this phase inherited the seed's purpose or refined it — and two rows are two answers to it

rule_set.intent: the one narrative no artifact can derive is authored once and never quietly replaced

params.detail: the purpose is declared INHERITED and does not match the seed's — inherit it word for word, or declare REFINED and say what this phase adds

rule_set.intent: superseding upstream content is allowed, doing it without saying so is not

params.detail: a refined purpose must state what it adds that the seed did not say; silence here is the silent replacement this register exists to prevent

rule_set.intent: every subdomain a change touches has its purpose stated
a subdomain a change authors into names the artifacts it authors
a provisional code names what to build, never where it will live

params.detail: {token!r} in {column!r} — a provisional code carrying a namespace has already been placed, and placement is Stage 7's decision

rule_set.intent: a provisional code is readable as a family, a name and a version

params.detail: provisional code must be FAMILY_NAME_V<n> with no namespace

rule_set.intent: a code and the family it is filed under agree
a capability borrowed from elsewhere must be one that really exists
intent says what must be true, never how it is wired

params.detail: {token!r} in {column!r} — a path, a binding expression or a hash is an implementation decision, and Stage 7 owns those

rule_set.intent: every invariant is answerable to the business, not to the design

params.detail: invariant states no business reason — a rule without one is a technical constraint and belongs elsewhere

rule_set.intent: identity semantics are stated, never inferred from field names

params.detail: identity declares no uniqueness rule — what a duplicate means is irreducible business knowledge the compiler cannot infer

rule_set.intent: an event names an occurrence, and a code in the imperative names an operation

params.detail: {value!r} does not name a moment that has happened — an event code reads EV_<subject>_<participle>, as EV_ACTOR_REGISTERED_V0 does

rule_set.intent: an unanswered question left in a register reads as decided to every later phase

params.detail: {column!r} declares the question unanswered ({marker}) rather than answering it — ask it as a clarification, do not hedge it in a register
